gamma=0.001 first 14.3T tokens, 0 for last 500B; sequence-wise alpha=0.0001
each token to at most M=4 nodes chosen by sum of top K_r/M scores per node; 256 routed experts on 64 GPUs of 8 nodes
no token dropping in training or inference
NVLink 160 GB/s ≈3.2× IB 50 GB/s; avg 3.2 experts/node, up to 13 experts same cost; 20 of 132 SMs for communication
compute:comm ≈1:1 for cross-node EP; DualPipe overlaps; 2× parameter copies; PP16, EP64, ZeRO-1, no TP

all three Linear GEMMs FP8; 1×128 / 128×128 scaling; ~14-bit accumulation, promote every 128; E4M3 everywhere; <0.25% relative loss error at ~16B and ~230B; block-wise Dgrad diverges ~300B tokens on 16B

hindsight_claims.claim: Keep Routing adopted since V3-0324: train/inference routing inconsistency destabilizes MoE RL

V4: Sqrt(Softplus) affinity; node-limit removed; hash routing for first 3 MoE layers; MoE-outlier loss spikes, Anticipatory Routing (~20% overhead when on) and SwiGLU clamping; FP4 routed expert weights
V4 EP: comm fully hidden when C/B ≤ 2d (6144 for V4-Pro); RL rollout long-tail small batches
V4.1-Flash: modality-specific aux-free biases; concatenated routing-replay in async RL
Kimi K2: 384 experts, no expert grouping, 1 dense layer, 64 heads; no DualPipe (doubles param/grad memory); no FP8 compute
Kimi K3: fixed-step bias update trades slow adaptation vs oscillation; Quantile Balancing for 896 experts
Qwen3: no shared experts; global-batch balance loss
Llama 4: alternating dense/MoE for inference efficiency; Behemoth FP8 pretraining

boundaries: Training cost excludes prior research and ablations
